<div class="card-body">
'''Mosep''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊モゼップ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">敵がモゼップのいる位置か隣接する位置でのフォース消耗によってフォースを失う場合、フォースは必ずリザーブ・デッキから失われる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Mosep-PSA-160005375.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ジャバの帳簿係をつとめるニムバニーズ。内通者を通じてハットの敵たちの資金の流れを阻害する。失敗すれば次には自分が“帳消し”になるのだ、ということを肝に銘じている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Mosep.

'''Card text:'''
When opponent loses Force by Force drain at Mosep's location or an adjacent location, the Force must be lost from Reserve Deck.

'''Lore:'''
A Nimbanel who keeps Jabba's books. Through inside contacts he disrupts the cash flow of the Hutt's enemies. He takes to heart that if he fails, he will be the next “write-off.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese フォース消耗 is Force drain.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Mosep]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
